verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਆਮ ਵੇਦ ਕਉ ਸੋਧਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਥਿ ਵੇਦਾਂਤੁ ਬਿਆਸਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: siaam vedh kau sodh kar math vedhaa(n)t biaas sunaiaa|

en.bdb: Vyas (Badarayan) recited Vedanta (sutras) after churning and researching the thought frame of the Samaveda.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kathanee badhanee baaharaa aape apanaa braham janaiaa|

en.bdb: He put up before the self  (atman) as identical to indescribable Brahm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਿਆਵਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: nadharee kisai na liaaviee haumai a(n)dhar bharam bhulaiaa|

en.bdb: He in invisible and the jiv wanders hither and thither in its delusions of self conceit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਪੁਜਾਇ ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aap pujai jagat vich bhaau bhagat dhaa maram na paiaa|

en.bdb: By establishing the self as the Brahm he is in fact established one's own self as worthy of worship and therefore remained unknown to the mysteries of loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਵੇਦਿ ਮਥਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤਪਤਿ ਤਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: tirapat na aavee vedh math aganee a(n)dhar tapat tapaiaa|

en.bdb: Churning of the Vedas could not obtain peace for him and he started scorching one and all in the heat of is ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਡੰਡ ਨ ਉਤਰੇ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੈ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਰੂਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: maiaa dda(n)dd na utare jam dda(n)ddai bahu dhukh rooaaiaa|

en.bdb: The rod of maya always hung over his head and he suffered extremely because of the constant fear of the Yama, the god of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਮਥਿ ਭਾਗਵਤ ਗੁਨਿ ਗੀਤ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: naaradh mun upadhesiaa math bhaagavat gun geet karaiaa|

en.bdb: Having obtained knowledge from Narad, he recited Bhagvat and thus eulogised God.
Without surrender before the Guru none could get across (the world ocean).
